description.zh:
报警生效的结束时间。取值范围：0~23。

例如：`AlertConfig.StartTime`为0，`AlertConfig.EndTime`为22，表示报警生效时间为00:00:00至22:00:00。

>如果报警不在生效时间内，则超过阈值也不会发送报警通知。
description.en:
The end time when the alert takes effect. Valid values: 0 to 23.

For example, if `AlertConfig.StartTime` is set to 0 and `AlertConfig.EndTime` is set to 22, the alert is effective from 00:00:00 to 22:00:00.

>If the alert is not within the effective period, no alert notification is sent even if the threshold is exceeded.

description.zh:
报警通知类型。取值：

<props="china">- 2：电话+短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- 1：短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- 0：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>


<props="intl">0：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="partner">0：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>
description.en:
The alert notification type. Valid values:

<props="china">- 2: phone call + text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- 1: text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- 0: email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="partner">0: email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

description.zh: 通道沉默时间。单位：秒，默认值：86400（1天）。
description.en: The mute period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

description.zh:
报警生效的开始时间。取值范围：0~23。

例如：`AlertConfig.StartTime`为0，`AlertConfig.EndTime`为22，表示报警生效时间为00:00:00至22:00:00。

>如果报警不在生效时间内，则超过阈值也不会发送报警通知。
description.en:
The start time when the alert takes effect. Valid values: 0 to 23.

For example, if `AlertConfig.StartTime` is set to 0 and `AlertConfig.EndTime` is set to 22, the alert is effective from 00:00:00 to 22:00:00.

>If the alert is not within the effective period, no alert notification is sent even if the threshold is exceeded.

description.zh: URL回调地址。
description.en: The webhook address.

description.zh: 无。
description.en: None.

description.zh:
报警统计方法。N的取值范围：1~21。不同监控项的取值如下：

- HttpStatus：Value。
- HttpLatency：Average。
- TelnetStatus：Value。
- TelnetLatency：Average。
- PingLostRate：Average。

>状态码类的统计方法为原始值（Value），延时时间或丢包率的统计方法为平均值（Average）。
description.en:
The statistical method for the alert. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. The valid values vary based on the metric:

- HttpStatus: Value.
- HttpLatency: Average.
- TelnetStatus: Value.
- TelnetLatency: Average.
- PingLostRate: Average.

>The statistical method for status codes is the original value (Value). The statistical method for latency or packet loss rate is the average value (Average).

description.zh:
报警的监控项。N的取值范围：1~21。取值：

- HttpStatus：HTTP状态码。
- HttpLatency：HTTP等待时间。
- TelnetStatus：Telnet状态码。
- TelnetLatency：Telnet等待时间。
- PingLostRate：Ping丢包率。
description.en:
The metric for the alert. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. Valid values:

- HttpStatus: HTTP status code.
- HttpLatency: HTTP latency.
- TelnetStatus: Telnet status code.
- TelnetLatency: Telnet latency.
- PingLostRate: Ping packet loss rate.

The comparison operator for the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. Valid values:

- `>`
- `>=`
- `<`
- `<=`
- `=`

description.zh: 报警重试次数。N的取值范围：1~21。
description.en: The number of alert retries. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

description.zh: 报警阈值。N的取值范围：1~21。
description.en: The alert threshold. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

description.zh: 报警触发目标。
description.en: The alert trigger targets.

description.zh: 应用分组ID。
description.en: The application group ID.

description.zh:
发起探测的ECS实例列表。N的取值范围：1~21。

> 当`TaskScope`为`GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE`时，需要设置该参数。
description.en:
The list of ECS instances that initiate detection. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

> Set this parameter when `TaskScope` is set to `GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE`.

description.zh: 可用性监控任务名称。取值范围：4~100个字符，支持英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和汉字。
description.en: The name of the availability monitoring task. The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters.

description.zh:
HTTP请求的Header。格式为`参数名:参数`，多个参数之间用回车符分隔，例如：
```
params1:value1
params2:value2
```
description.en:
The header of the HTTP request. The format is `Parameter name:Parameter value`. Separate multiple parameters with line breaks. Example:
```
params1:value1
params2:value2
```

description.zh:
探测类型的方法。取值：

- GET
- POST
- HEAD

>如果任务的探测类型为HTTP，则需要设置该参数。
description.en:
The method for the detection type. Valid values:

- GET
- POST
- HEAD

>If the detection type is HTTP, set this parameter.

description.zh:
匹配HTTP响应内容的报警规则。取值：
- true：如果HTTP响应内容包含设置的报警规则，则报警。
- false：如果HTTP响应内容不包含设置的报警规则，则报警。

>如果任务的探测类型为HTTP，则该参数生效。
description.en:
The alert rule for matching HTTP response content. Valid values:
- true: An alert is triggered if the HTTP response content contains the specified alert rule content.
- false: An alert is triggered if the HTTP response content does not contain the specified alert rule content.

>This parameter takes effect only when the detection type is HTTP.

description.zh: HTTP探测类型探测请求的Post内容。
description.en: The POST content of the HTTP detection request.

description.zh:
HTTP探测类型的响应字符集。

> 仅支持UTF-8。
description.en:
The response character set for HTTP detection.

> Only UTF-8 is supported.

description.zh: 匹配响应的内容。
description.en: The content to match in the response.

description.zh: HTTP、Telnet探测类型的探测URI地址。
description.en: The URI for HTTP or Telnet detection.

The detection frequency. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 900, 1800, and 3600.

> Only CloudMonitor agent 3.5.1 or later supports this parameter.

description.zh:
探测的域名或地址。
>如果探测任务类型为PING，则需要设置该参数。
description.en:
The domain name or address to detect.
>If the detection type is PING, set this parameter.

description.zh:
可用性监控任务的探测范围。取值：

- GROUP：表示将当前应用分组内的所有ECS实例作为探测任务的探针。
- GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE：表示将当前应用分组内的指定ECS实例作为探测任务的探针。设置该参数时，需要同时设置InstanceList（发起探测的ECS实例列表）。
description.en:
The detection scope of the availability monitoring task. Valid values:

- GROUP: uses all ECS instances in the current application group as detection probes.
- GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE: uses specified ECS instances in the current application group as detection probes. If you set this parameter to GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE, you must also set InstanceList to specify the ECS instances that initiate detection.

description.zh:
可用性监控任务的探测类型。取值：

- PING
- TELNET
- HTTP
description.en:
The detection type of the availability monitoring task. Valid values:

- PING
- TELNET
- HTTP

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，在应用分组`123456`中创建探测类型为`HTTP`的可用性监控任务`task1`，通过邮件和钉钉机器人给您发送报警。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to create an availability monitoring task named `task1` with the detection type `HTTP` in the application group `123456`. Alert notifications are sent by email and DingTalk chatbot.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms create-host-availability --group-id 123456 --task-name task1 --task-scope GROUP --task-type HTTP --task-option-http-uri https://www.aliyun.com_telnet://127.0.0.1:80 --task-option-telnet-or-ping-host www.aliyun.com --task-option-http-response-charset UTF-8 --task-option-http-post-content params1=paramsValue1 --task-option-http-response-match-content ok --task-option-http-method GET --task-option-http-negative true --task-option-http-header token:testTokenValue --task-option-interval 60 --alert-config-notify-type 0 --alert-config-start-time 0 --alert-config-end-time 22 --alert-config-silence-time 86400 --alert-config-web-hook https://www.aliyun.com/webhook.json --alert-config-escalation-list Operator=example-string MetricName=HttpStatus Times=3 Value=90 Aggregate=Value --instance-list 2 --alert-config-target-list JsonParams=customField1_:_value1_,_customField2_:_.name Level=INFO_,_WARN_,_CRITICAL Id=1 Arn=acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:1208863178610000:/queues/test/message --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms CreateHostAvailability --region cn-hangzhou --TaskOption.TelnetOrPingHost 'www.aliyun.com' --TaskOption.HttpPostContent 'params1=paramsValue1' --AlertConfig.NotifyType 0 --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Value 90 --AlertConfigTargetList.1.Id 1 --TaskOption.Interval 60 --AlertConfig.EndTime 22 --TaskType HTTP --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Operator 'example-string' --TaskOption.HttpResponseMatchContent ok --TaskOption.HttpHeader 'token:testTokenValue' --AlertConfigTargetList.1.Arn 'acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:1208863178610000:/queues/test/message' --AlertConfigTargetList.1.Level 'INFO_,_WARN_,_CRITICAL' --AlertConfig.SilenceTime 86400 --TaskScope GROUP --TaskOption.HttpMethod GET --AlertConfig.WebHook 'https://www.aliyun.com/webhook.json' --GroupId 123456 --AlertConfig.StartTime 0 --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Times 3 --TaskOption.HttpResponseCharset 'UTF-8' --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Aggregate Value --AlertConfigTargetList.1.JsonParams 'customField1_:_value1_,_customField2_:_.name' --TaskName task1 --TaskOption.HttpURI 'https://www.aliyun.com_telnet://127.0.0.1:80' --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.MetricName HttpStatus --InstanceList.1 2 --TaskOption.HttpNegative true --method POST --force
